I was checking my bank statement and found several fraudulent charges from a business called www.mossbrady.com. I had never heard of them, never ordered their services. I called and emailed them and never got any response. (I reported it to my bank and am getting a new debit card). I have no idea how they got my bank information, these were several recurring charges from them, each at $49.99 and totaling $499.91.

The "company" popped up as an ad on my phone. Once I clicked on it, it then attempted to take my PayPal information. I never signed up for an account. Each day since, the company is attempting to charge my credit card $29.90 per day. My CC company is declining it. I tried emailing the support@uryogajourney.com to stop this charge attempt, and the email address is getting sent back and is not a real email account.

I saw an ad for sweaters and signed up for email to get discount and then saw a charge on my card. I immediately reported it and sent several emails to the company to refund and cancel as there mist have been a mistake a purvhase was made in error as I was just looking for discount for future possible purchase but after researching the company appeared to be a scam. No money was returned and sweaters did not arrive nor was the email thread answered.
I received an email from The entity inviting me to take a survey to win a $1000 Amazon card.

Many order was placed on this websites by customers and myself included.  Many customers like myself haven't received their orders and been waiting for months after being promised too. There has been many reviews and complaints about the scam website trying to find answers and warn others from falling into their trap. The company gives us no updates and when a refund was requested, they don't reply back. When emailing the company they replied it's already processed. Tried emailing them again this week after 4 months of waiting and the email is now not working and bounced back. This website needs to be shutdown before more people are getting scammed for their money. Thank you.

They left me a voicemail stating they would deliver documents between 8 am and 4 pm, two attempts would be made at my home address and my work address. After that I would be listed as non compliant and then I would be listed for processing
I made the mistake of calling back, then they refused to tell me what company they were and were belligerent and ended up hanging up on me.
They are using predatory practices to collect debts from debts which are not owed
